run_speaker_probing_training: run the speaker probing training script with hubert or cpc dense models on LibriSpeech data
train_speaker_classifier: train a speaker classification model using baseline discrete or continuous classifier types
evaluate_speaker_model: evaluate a trained speaker probing model and print validation loss and accuracy metrics
create_speaker_dataset_wrapper: create a SpeakerDatasetWrapper to map speaker IDs and truncate sequences from quantized LibriSpeech data
set_random_seed: set the random seed for both CPU and CUDA PyTorch operations for reproducibility
